text:
jen: Heads up — we're seeing a spike of OOMs in eu-west embeddings workers after the runtime kernel selector change rolled at 09:12 UTC. ~12% of requests get 500s and pods restart.
mike: saw it in dashboards, alert fired 09:23. Is this the new quant kernel? any quick mitigation?
kat: yes it's the kernel selector path. New path picks a larger memory kernel for short sequences in some models. Regression estimate: memory bump on ~30% of kvcache allocations.
jen: impact is mostly embeddings and small-batch generation on dedicated pools, affects eu-west only so far.
duty: severity? customer-facing errors or internal only?
jen: customer-facing, embedding calls returning 500s. Some customers reporting degraded latency.
kat: suggest hotfix build: revert to kernel-selector v1.9 and a tuned fallback that caps per-request kv allocation. Patch candidate: release v2.3.1-hotfix-kvcap.
jen: request expedited approval to fast-track patch and skip full 30m canary because canary already partially exercised (we have 10% traffic on canary nodes but it's failing).
deploybot: [deploybot] Job queued: deploy/5112345678 -> target: eu-west1 dedicated-pool (canary=2 nodes). CI: green. Dry-run: passed.
tatiana: we should still do staggered rollout across AZs, but can do a short 5m sanity window per AZ rather than full 30m canary.
mike: +1 to stagger, but if errors are customer-facing we need faster mitigation. I approve expedited with operational safeguards.
kat: plan: 1) pin version to v2.3.1-hotfix on canary nodes only; 2) monitor embeddings 2xx/5xx + memory; 3) if <1% errors in 10m per AZ, continue to 50% traffic; 4) auto-rollback threshold: >2% 5xx sustained for 2m.
duty: I approve. tagging oncall and infra: please monitor and be ready to rollback. :thumbsup:
jen: added quick release-note stub: "v2.3.1-hotfix: revert kernel-selector memory regression, cap KV allocation to avoid OOMs; rollouts staggered in eu-west." Will push final notes after deploy.
kat: rollout commands below (ops):

```
# pin canary
redwoodctl rollout set --cluster eu-west1 --pool embeddings-dedicated --image redwood/runtime:v2.3.1-hotfix --strategy canary --canary-nodes 2
# monitor
redwoodctl monitor metrics --query "sum(errors{code=500,region=eu-west1}) by (pool)"
# rollback (if needed)
redwoodctl rollout revert --cluster eu-west1 --pool embeddings-dedicated --to-image redwood/runtime:v2.3.0
```

mike: noted. I'll keep an eye on SLOs and customer pings.
sre-bot: [incident] created INC-2026-eu-embed-ooms by jen. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/embeddings-oom
tatiana: infra: prepared extra ephemeral nodes to absorb failed pods if needed. also prepared k8s cordon/uncordon script.
deploybot: [deploybot] Canary start: 5112345700 -> nodes: eu-west1-a, eu-west1-b
jen: canary in progress. monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards/redwood/embed-eu-west
mike: seeing initial 5xx drop from 12% -> 3% on canary nodes after patch. memory spikes reduced.
kat: good. hold 10m and if stable move to 50%.
jen: 10m sanity window passed. errors on canary 0.6%, overall eu-west still ~3% because of old nodes.
mike: proceed to 50% traffic.
deploybot: [deploybot] Traffic shift: 50% -> started 5112345770
jen: monitoring — errors trending down to 0.4% on updated nodes, latency normalizing.
duty: consensus: proceed to full rollout unless we cross auto-rollback threshold. I authorize final push for eu-west region.
kat: executing full rollout now.
deploybot: [deploybot] Full rollout started 5112345780 -> targeting remaining nodes in eu-west1
jen: release note final: "v2.3.1-hotfix — fixes memory regression introduced by kernel-selector change; stabilizes embeddings; urgent hotfix rolled in eu-west with staggered canary and 5m AZ windows."
mike: posting notify to customers impacted and to status page.
jen: customer-facing post drafted, will publish after final verification. cc @duty
sre-bot: [incident] INC-2026 updated: mitigated, monitoring continued.
kat: final check — no new OOMs for 12m across region, rolling closed.
jen: marking thread resolved. thanks all :heart:
